name: gowanew
description: Go WhatsApp API Gateway with Glassmorphic Web UI

scripts.start: cd src && go run -tags purego . rest
scripts.build: npm --prefix ../golangwaui run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('storages/ui',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('../golangwaui/dist/index.html','storages/ui/index.html'); console.log('UI pre-seeded to storages/ui/index.html');"
